# PHASE 5 — Risk Assessment

## Risk Level: LOW

## Changes Applied
1. `language.service.ts` — 54 translation keys added to TRANSLATIONS constant. No logic changed.
2. `search.component.html` — UI text bindings only. Search logic, signals, and router untouched.
3. `search.component.ts` — `LanguageService` injected (readonly); `searchTypes` label strings moved to `labelKey` (translation key reference). All search logic untouched.
4. `search.component.scss` — `margin-right` → `margin-inline-end` (CSS logical property). No layout change in LTR; fixes icon position in RTL.
5. `reports-list.component.html` — UI text bindings only. All ngModel bindings, form logic, and modal behavior untouched.
6. `reports-list.component.ts` — `LanguageService` injected; `reportTypes` label → `labelKey`; `getReportTypeLabel()` updated to call `langService.t()`. All report generation, download, delete logic untouched.
7. `report-viewer.component.html` — UI text bindings only. innerHTML binding, sanitizer usage, download logic untouched.
8. `report-viewer.component.ts` — `LanguageService` injected (readonly). No behavior change.
9. `notifications.component.html` / `.ts` — NO CHANGES (already localized).

## What Was NOT Changed
- Search algorithms, queries, or state management
- Report generation or export logic
- Notification delivery or state management
- Mock Mode, Demo Mode behavior
- NgRx store, effects, reducers, selectors
- Routing and guards
- Services
- Backend/Grok/Gemini preparation code
- Responsive design breakpoints
- DomSanitizer usage in report-viewer

- Report cover brand name "AegisLex" — product name, not translated
- Copyright notice "AegisLex © 2024" — legal notice
- Report section titles (AI-generated content, not UI labels)
